family_name: BETDIS — cross-symbol beta-break market-neutral dislocation convergence
one_line: A market-neutral spread book on the frozen 3-symbol H1 panels that enters only when realized co-movement between two co-listed perps breaks its own trailing beta by a frozen z-band, harvesting the forced hedge-ratio rebalancing of portfolio-margin market-neutral books; the declared representation is the beta-neutralized residual spread return, never a per-symbol state.

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_buy_or_sell: On Binance USD-M perpetuals, portfolio-margin accounts and cross-symbol basis books run market-neutral pairs (e.g. long BTCUSDT perp / short SOLUSDT perp) hedged at a trailing beta ratio. Their hedge RATIO, not direction, is the managed quantity. When realized co-movement breaks the trailing beta beyond a band, every such book's hedge ratio is mechanically wrong: cross-margin stress and risk-policy rebalancing FORCE ratio-restoring flow in the dislocated leg (buy the under-mover, sell the over-mover) independent of directional view. This forced flow is expressed by price (the dislocation itself), funding (the two legs' settlement cash flows diverge while the spread is open — a cost line the mechanism must pay), and OI-LEVEL (the diagnostic signature: ratio rebalancing shifts OI mass far less than new directional flow — declared non-scored confirm only).
mechanism.why_convergence_is_expected: The dislocated pair's spread reverts as the hedged population restores its ratio and cross-symbol arb re-prices the residual; the entry is on the side the forced rebalancing must trade.
when_it_must_fail: Idiosyncratic single-symbol news dislocations: no hedged population is off-ratio, no forced flow, no convergence — expectancy dies after costs.

Beta-break as the LEAD of a vol regime (break = shock onset): the residual inherits the vol shock — the book should then die at the mandatory dvol_shock kill-check; survival there is the design's main empirical question.
A hedged population too small on this exchange in this window: forced flow is absent; the randomized-event-time sham will then out-earn the anchor and the family is falsified by its own control.
Too few break events in a fold: fold-population kill (< 4 decisions in any fold) dies before selection, exactly as NG3-A5 died at 2<4.

signal_features: r_s(t) = log(last_price_s(t) / last_price_s(t-1)) per symbol per H1 bar (panel-native)
beta_AB rolling OLS slope of r_legA on r_legB over trailing 720 bars, updated at each bar close, PIT-strict (uses bars <= t-1 only)

residual e_AB(t) = r_legA(t) - beta_AB(t-1) * r_legB(t); z_AB(t) = e_AB(t) / rolling 720-bar MAD-to-sigma of e_AB; lag discipline: every state at t uses data through t-1 close, decision at t close, entry at t+1 open
features_and_lags.explicit_non_features: OI enters no feature; funding enters no feature; session/day-of-week/weekend enter no feature; per-symbol volume/tape aggregates enter no feature (residualization removes the common tape state from the representation level — declared, then measured at D2)

entry_exit_fills.entry: at H1 bar t close, if |z_AB(t)| >= 2.5 and no open position on pair AB: enter at next bar t+1 first_price (conservative panel-native open proxy; no lookahead), leg sizes 1 : -beta_AB(t-1) rounded to the frozen sizing grid, both legs filled as taker
entry_exit_fills.exit: fixed horizon H = 24 H1 bars (1 day) exit at the H-th bar's last_price, OR early if |z_AB| crosses 0 mid-window at a bar close (convergence exit), whichever first; force-flat at fold boundary
entry_exit_fills.non_overlap: one position per pair at a time; three pairs run independently
entry_exit_fills.cost_kernel: L-V14-0 law: cost charged exactly once per fill (4 fills per round trip: 2 entry + 2 exit), measured taker + half-spread; stress multiplier 2.0 applied to booked PnL as a PRIMARY gate; costs broken out fills vs holding; funding charged per settlement timestamp inside the holding window on both legs (up to 3 settlements x 2 legs per 1-day hold); gross cap 1.0, symbol cap 0.10; break-even bps reported per cell
entry_exit_fills.dual_book: price-only book and financing-inclusive book reported side by side; no claim may rest on gross or pre-funding performance

If any fires, the family dies with its margin recorded — no relabel rescue.
